xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4457: Linked PRs never show where the operator looks

plan.title: Linked PRs never show where the operator looks: all 159 links sit on hidden agent conversations; adopt t3code's thread PR surfacing
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Code touches only src/lib, src/dashboard and one call site in src/cli (22 files under the 25 limit); the subsystem count exceeds 6 only because each of the four documentation pages (features/conversations.mdx, features/mission-control.mdx, configuration/workspaces.mdx, docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md) and root package.json (frontend test subset) count as separate subsystems. The three slices share one adapter and one link door, so splitting would only scatter the docs.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck stores 159 PR links (PAN-3822) but all sit on agent conversations, which Command Deck's conversation list hides. Operator conversations in the primary checkout are never branch-matched, created links only reach -review agent conversations since the PAN-3917 Cut, and issue rows show only a neutral open-PR chip that converges every 5 minutes with no checks or review state.
narratives.Proposal: (1) Render the existing PullRequestBadge on Command Deck issue rows and sidebar issue-workspace rows from DerivedIssueState.pr through a small adapter, and refresh that derived state (fresh PR listing) when startRequestReviewPipeline accepts a request, which pan done calls right after opening the PR. (2) Branch-match operator conversations in the primary checkout when their pane is live at sweep time (backend-agnostic pane inventory); merged links persist because the sweep never deletes. (3) Pipeline-created links also reach operator conversations whose cwd is inside the issue workspace. Docs updated on four pages.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No agent-callable link tool, PR side panel, or extra refresh triggers on branch change, turn end, or window focus (issue item 4)
- No unhiding of agent conversations in listConversations() or the Command Deck conversation list
- No change to packages/contracts schemas (DerivedPrState, PullRequestSnapshot, PullRequestLink)
- No new HTTP route and no new or changed CLI verb or flag
- No periodic derived-state refresh timer; hand-opened PRs without webhooks keep today's cadence
- No change to auto-archive-on-merge or its tmux-only liveness read
- No edit to src/dashboard/server/services/issue-data-service.ts (at its file-size cap)
- Issue rows never show a closed-unmerged PR

autoDecisions.summary: Scope is issue items 1-3; item 4 (link tool, PR side panel, extra refresh triggers) is a NonGoal
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue orders scope smallest first and labels item 4 'follow-ups worth adopting'; acceptance criteria cover only 1-3.

autoDecisions.summary: Issue and workspace rows read the PR from DerivedIssueState.pr, rendered through the existing PullRequestBadge via a frontend adapter
autoDecisions.rationale: Derived state already carries checks and review state over /ws/rpc; reusing the badge keeps PAN-3822's single tone law and avoids a contracts schema change.

autoDecisions.summary: Meet the 60 s AC by refreshing the issue's derived state (with an invalidated PR listing) inside startRequestReviewPipeline
autoDecisions.rationale: pan done calls this door right after opening the PR and the GitHub webhook routes hand-opened PRs there; derived state otherwise refreshes only on tracker changes and the listing can be cached 5 min.

autoDecisions.summary: Primary-checkout operator conversations are branch-matched only while their pane is live; unknown liveness skips them
autoDecisions.rationale: t3code keys detection on a per-thread recorded branch that Overdeck lacks; without a liveness guard every conversation in a shared checkout would permanently collect the PR of any branch the checkout drifts onto.

autoDecisions.summary: Liveness comes from the backend-agnostic pane inventory (getBackendPanes + paneAgentKey), not the sweep's tmux-only session list
autoDecisions.rationale: Conversations launch through the terminal-backend door (Herdr by default since PAN-3921), so tmux list-sessions would report them all dead.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Stays after merge' is proven by a test, with no new mechanism
autoDecisions.rationale: upsertBranchPullRequestLink only inserts, the sweep never deletes, and merged snapshots are never re-read.

autoDecisions.summary: Created links match operator conversations by cwd equal to or under the workspace path using instr(), not LIKE
autoDecisions.rationale: Workspace paths can contain '_' which is a LIKE wildcard; instr gives an exact prefix test.

autoDecisions.summary: Document the change in features/conversations.mdx, docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, configuration/workspaces.mdx and features/mission-control.mdx, with a sizeJustification for the subsystem count
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names conversations.mdx and docs/; the two row surfaces are documented on the workspaces and mission-control pages.

items.title: Issue PR badge adapter and widened PullRequestBadge prop

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Export `PullRequestBadgeLink = Pick<PullRequestLink,'url'|'number'|'repository'|'snapshot'>` from PullRequestBadge.tsx and use it for pullRequestBadgeTone, pullRequestBadgeLabel, StateIcon and the PullRequestBadge `link` prop. Extend pullRequestBadgeLabel with module-scope CHECKS_LABEL/REVIEW_LABEL maps (checks passing/failing/pending; approved/changes requested/review requested/commented; review omitted for none), replacing the two old checks/changes-requested lines. New issuePullRequest.ts exports issuePullRequestBadgeLink(pr: DerivedPrState|undefined, resourcePrs=[]) exactly as in the PRD snippet (state merged/open, draft+title from the matching resourcePrs entry, nulls elsewhere, syncedAt ''; null when pr is undefined or parsePullRequestRef(pr.url) fails). Write issuePullRequest.test.ts with the PRD cases and add it to root package.json test:frontend-subset.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. Add tmuxSession to PullRequestSyncConversation (select tmux_session, fallback `conv-${name}`). In the sweep add listLivePaneAgentIds() (getBackendPanes, null when isBackendInventoryDegraded or on throw, set of paneAgentKey for panes not 'exited'), a 4th optional runPullRequestSyncOnce parameter defaulting to it, read once per sweep and passed to syncProject, which passes live = set ? set.has(tmuxSession) : null. Update module header step 3. In the test file mock ../backend-inventory.js, rewrite (not delete) the 'never links an operator conversation in the primary checkout' test into the three liveness cases, and add the merged-link persistence test and the live-on-default-branch case.

items.title: Given an operator conversation in the primary checkout on feature/pan-3822 whose conv-<name> is in the live pane set, the sweep creates a branch link to PR 12

Given a branch link whose PR merged, a second sweep after the cwd branch becomes main (or null for a removed workspace) preserves the link with dismissedAt null and snapshot.state 'merged'

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7. Add optional workspacePath to linkCreatedPullRequestToIssueConversations; when set, also select non-archived, non-vault conversations with `cwd = ? OR instr(cwd, ?) = 1` (root, root + '/'), keep only non-agent names, union with the agent names (dedupe), and apply the existing skip rules and event emission. Update its doc comment. Pass workspacePath from done.ts openOrUpdatePullRequests and from review-artifacts.ts createReviewArtifactsForIssue. done.ts must not grow past its current line count.

items.title: Given operator conversations with cwd <ws> and <ws>/packages/x, the call with workspacePath <ws> creates a 'created' link on both and returns their names
